list.title: Payment methods
list.text: The ways customers can pay at checkout, in the order cashiers see them.
list.errorTitle: We couldn’t load the payment methods
list.errorText: Check your connection and try again.
list.dragNote: Drag the handle to change the order, or edit a method’s sort order.
list.emptyText: Add at least one so cashiers can take payments.

drawer.info: These record how a customer paid. They don’t connect to a bank or payment provider, and Vendora never asks for card details.
drawer.name: Name
drawer.isCashText: Counts toward the cash drawer and gives change.
drawer.referenceText: Cashiers must enter the transaction reference from the other app or terminal.
drawer.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers show first at checkout.

errors.codePattern: Use letters, numbers, dashes or underscores only.
errors.codeTaken: Another payment method already uses this code.
errors.failed: We couldn’t save the payment method. Check your connection and try again.
